jp: 何も情報なかったし・・・
en: This is bad... In the end, I found no information at all in town...

jp: サーカスに集まるお客さんが
en: I know! There might still be other customers coming to the circus!!

jp: 受付の人がいないけど
もう準備は出来たのかな？
en: ...Huh? There's nobody at the entrance. Are they ready to open yet?
Hey, you there! What are you doing!!
Huh?

jp: さてはここの関係者だな！？
en: Suspicious little... You're with this circus, aren't you!?
I'm not...

jp: かくまっている悪魔はどこだ！？
en: Answer me! Where is the demon you're hiding!?
I don't know anything about that!

jp: 答えないと言うなら・・・
en: If you refuse to answer...

jp: いきなり剣を突きつけるなんて
en: Whoa, whoa. Drawing a sword on a kid, just like that? The Church sure plays rough~

jp: 教団が刃を向ける相手は
en: Aren't the Church's blades meant for demons and heretics?
Who the hell are you!?

jp: ま、通りすがりのおせっかいな
お兄さんってとこかな？
en: Me? Just a nosy passerby, I guess you could say.
What!? You'd stand in our way? Then you're a heretic too!?

jp: いきなり異端者扱いかよ？
en: Whoa, whoa. Straight to calling me a heretic?

jp: こうなったら力ずくでも
悪魔の居場所を吐かせてやる！
en: Enough talk! We'll beat the demon's whereabouts out of you by force!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
